notes: All preprocessing is fitted only on each training split.
Continuous target metrics cover all participants/samples.
Macro classification averages participants equally; PR-AUC/ROC-AUC omit participants without both label classes as relevant.
Carbohydrate-on-board is a linear-decay feature proxy, not a validated physiology model.
Repeated fold seeds change participant assignment, not the cohort.

design.split: Chronological within each participant with a purged boundary: adaptation/training uses forecast rows whose exact t+120 label is observed by the 72-hour cutoff; rows forecast before the cutoff whose label arrives after it are purged; test uses rows forecast at or after the cutoff.
design.primary_eligibility_rule: At least 200 usable labeled forecast intervals in the fixed, label-purged early window and at least one later test interval. Rule uses timestamps and early data availability only, not held-out labels.
design.event_rich_secondary_rule: Descriptive subgroup only: at least 10 positive labels in both adaptation and test segments. Future labels are not used for primary inclusion or headline results.
design.hyperparameters: For each participant, use settings selected by grouped CV in a fold where that entire participant was held out; the participant's own timeline is excluded from its hyperparameter selection.

participant_counts_summary.calibration_layer_rule: Regularized 1-D logistic calibration of the population model's early-window scores; fit only when the first 72 hours have both classes and at least five positive windows, otherwise fall back to population scores. This fallback does not affect primary eligibility.

design.classifier_tuning: Inner participant-grouped average precision only; all preprocessing/model fits use training participants.
design.regression_tuning: The full-fusion regressor is tuned by inner participant-grouped MAE and evaluated on the same outer participant assignments as classification. Regression baselines use the same held-out rows.

baseline_definitions.persistence: Future glucose estimate and risk score equal current observed glucose; missing values use the training-participant median.
baseline_definitions.trend_extrapolation: Current glucose plus the observed 60-minute slope extrapolated to 120 minutes; missing values use the training-participant median.

design.selection_caveat: The reduced-EHR and HbA1c-only candidates were added after earlier cohort results were seen; choosing among them here is exploratory.

design.thresholds: Top 1%, 5%, and 10% cutoffs derived from inner participant-grouped OOF predictions on training participants, applied unchanged to held-out outer folds.
design.episode_rule: Observed future CGM readings >=180 mg/dL; merge readings with gaps <= 30 minutes.
design.alert_rule: Retain first threshold-crossing prediction then suppress alerts for 60 minutes. Both rules are exploratory assumptions requiring clinician input and prospective validation.
design.detection_rule: Early detection requires alert time before episode onset and forecast target within that episode; post-onset alerts are counted separately.
design.denominator_note: Participant prediction days approximate prediction opportunities divided by 96 at 15-minute cadence; recording gaps mean this is not exact wear time.

hba1c_strata_seed_42_bootstrap.source: 120-minute seed-42 held-out OOF predictions; resampled participants as clusters.
hba1c_strata_seed_42_bootstrap.limitations: Intervals condition on fixed out-of-fold predictions and do not include model-refit uncertainty. Healthy-range events come from very few participants; interpret subgroup estimates cautiously.
